_comment: Shared race rules (design/gdd/races-and-classes.md 3.5-3.7). starter_races: the race a class card starts with (Boss 2026-11-13); old saves without a race get it too. vocabulary: the ONLY effect types / events / actions / targets / centers / pseudo-stats a race file may use; anything else fails the load (logic/race_data.gd). Status ids are checked against data/combat/effects.json. The engine (logic/race_passives.gd) runs stat_mod and trigger (apply_status, heal) today; the other entries load but stay inert until their phase-4 feature is built. Numbers are placeholders until class_sim measures them.

alliance.name: Alliance
alliance.text: Three different races: max HP +8%, ATK +8%.

_ultimates: Race ultimates (GDD 3.10). ultimates_enabled: the race engine owns the ultimate gauge of squad cards (it fills by formula 4.7 and is not wiped by the skill system); false = the gauge stays retired as before. gauge: the shared rule, per second of combat (time), per 100% of own ATK dealt (dealt), per 1% of own max HP taken after shields (taken), per 100% of own ATK healed/shielded to other allies (support), per kill (kill); each class scales dealt/taken/support with its own gauge block, each ultimate the whole gain with charge_mul.
_enemy_ranks: Which enemy types count as the boss / an elite for the pilot (longbow boss_first, magic skill hold, ultimate use rules).
